title: How Pip works
question: How does this assistant work?
facts: Pip is the assistant on this portfolio, built by Jay. A small Node.js server calls the OpenAI Responses API and requires structured JSON output whose sources must be IDs from a curated knowledge file, so answers stay grounded and cite their notes. Requests are validated with Zod and protected by an origin allowlist, per-client rate limits and a request budget. When the AI is offline, Pip shows the saved notes instead.
